_comment: Deterministic vulnerable-target definitions for the LIVE benchmark runner (Gap #6). Each target is a self-contained Docker stack whose proof-of-compromise is a build-time-injected flag token. The live runner mints a per-run flag (catalog flag + nonce), writes it to the target's flag_file/secret at build time, stands the stack up, runs ARGUS against the entrypoint, then scores ARGUS output against that exact token. Requires Docker on Kali/CI; not used by the offline replay/scoring path.

targets.flag_sink: /var/flag (readable only after the SQLi auth-bypass reaches the admin panel)
/root/flag (printed by the JNDI callback payload on successful RCE)
/srv/flag (returned in order #2's JSON body — another user's record)
(detection-only — no flag; passes on a TLS finding)
system_prompt (the model is seeded with the flag in its system prompt; leaking it proves the injection)
